Introductory treatment with examples, Yoneda, adjoints, limits; manuscript freely available.
Author-hosted overview and private-use book access; mathematical reference, not replicated text.

description: Develops sheaves from presheaves and restriction maps, expressing unique gluing by an equalizer. Examples distinguish constant presheaves from constant sheaves, explain stalks and sheafification, and show why local solutions on a circle need not admit compatible global angle coordinates.
